title: Bathroom Poo Sign
author: PrintedLayers
description:
Caution Poo Bathroom Door Hanger

Couple years ago I saw a small a frame sign online and had always thought it would make a great bathroom door hanger sign.

I modeled it with both signs. Can print one or the other. Or both. I personally glued both of them together back to back. When the bathroom is occupied one side faces out and upon leaving the bathroom flip the sign over.

Hope everyone enjoys this fun sign. And if you like it enough, please give it a boost if you can.
